description:
**Srijan Setu** is a **24-hour hackathon** by **Google Developer Groups on Campus: Indo Global College**, built around one simple idea — **turning ideas into meaningful solutions.**

Inspired by the spirit of **Spider-Man**, Srijan Setu is about using your skills, creativity, and technology with purpose. Just as every thread becomes stronger when it connects to another, great solutions are built when **people, ideas, and technology come together.**

# **Build. Connect. Create.**
Bring your team of **2–4 members**, choose a challenge from our innovation tracks, and spend 24 hours turning your idea into a working solution.

Whether you're a developer, designer, problem-solver, or someone with an idea worth building, **Srijan Setu is your space to experiment, collaborate, learn, and create.**


# **🧩 Innovation Tracks**

Explore challenges across:
**• HealthTech
• EdTech
• AgriTech
• E-Commerce
• Open Theme**

You can choose the domain that interests you and build a solution that addresses a meaningful problem.

# **Why Srijan Setu?**

This isn't just about writing code for 24 hours.

It's about **finding problems worth solving, building with purpose, learning from others, and connecting your ideas to real-world impact.**

Expect an environment where you can:

•💡 Turn ideas into working solutions
•🤝 Collaborate with people from different backgrounds
•🧠 Learn through hands-on building
•🛠️ Experiment with modern technologies
•🌐 Connect with fellow builders and the developer community
•🎯 Take your solution from concept to prototype

Use AI as a tool to think, build, experiment, and accelerate your development.

Your solution should still reflect your team's understanding, creativity, and contribution.

# **🕷️ Your Web Starts Here**

Every great solution begins with a connection — between a problem and an idea, an idea and technology, and technology and people.

**Srijan Setu is where those connections begin.**

hackathon_faqs.answer: Srijan Setu is open to students from all colleges.
hackathon_faqs.question: Who can participate in Srijan Setu?

hackathon_faqs.answer: Srijan Setu is an offline 24-hour hackathon hosted at Indo Global College, New Chandigarh, Punjab.
hackathon_faqs.question: Is Srijan Setu an online or offline hackathon?

hackathon_faqs.answer: Yes. Registration for Srijan Setu is completely free.
hackathon_faqs.question: Is registration free?
What is the duration of the hackathon?

hackathon_faqs.answer:
Participants can build solutions under the following tracks:

**• HealthTech
• EdTech
• AgriTech
• E-Commerce
• Open Theme**
hackathon_faqs.question: What are the innovation tracks?

hackathon_faqs.answer:
Yes. **AI tools and technologies are permitted** during Srijan Setu.

Teams should be able to understand and explain the AI-assisted components used in their solution.
hackathon_faqs.question: Can we use AI in our project?

hackathon_faqs.answer: Yes. Participants from different colleges can form a team, provided the team has 2–4 members.
hackathon_faqs.question: Can members from different colleges form a team?

hackathon_faqs.answer: You are free to choose the technologies and tools that best fit your solution, subject to the hackathon rules.
hackathon_faqs.question: What technologies can we use?
